nora (eng-rel): Heads-up: quick mid-week release train bulletin:
- Release freeze TONIGHT 23:00-23:45 UTC for DB migration (small schema add).
- We'll only accept `hotfix`-labeled PRs during the window.
- Canary will be limited to internal test accounts initially. No public traffic change.

kevin (release-engineer): Noted. I'll lock main for merges at 22:50 UTC and set CI gates.

leo (eng-oncall): Any expected downtime? DB migration should be online-only right?

nora (eng-rel): Correct — online schema migration with no downtime expected. We'll run verification queries during the freeze. If anything looks off, we'll abort and rollback.

deploy-bot: DB migration job queued: `migration/2026-03-24-add-shard-stats` scheduled at 2026-03-24T23:10:00Z

sre-oncall: I'll be watching tail latencies and connections. If we see connection spikes, we'll signal abort. Keep the rollback command handy: `infra db rollback --job migration/2026-03-24-add-shard-stats`

nora (eng-rel): Thanks. We'll post a short post-freeze note with outcome and any follow-ups. If you need an exception, ping @kevin and include the PR link.
